method: Themes are counted from the titles, summaries and tags of news and analysis items published in the window, using the keyword lists in config/themes.json. Countries are matched by name and by the aliases in config/places.json. The region of interest is the set of countries most often named in items about the most prevalent theme.

news.title: Refining Sovereignty: Russia and West Africa’s Gold Refinery Wave
news.author: Arman Sidhu
news.summary: Guinea, Burkina Faso, and Mali are building gold refineries several times larger than their own mines, without a London stamp for the bars.

news.title: Already Independent, Never Asked: Taiwan’s Missing Vote
news.author: Meng Kit Tang
news.summary: Taiwan’s president says the island is already independent, but rules both major parties wrote keep the question off the ballot.

news.title: Moscow and Beijing’s Asymmetric Bargain in the Black Sea and Central Asia
news.author: Tolga Demiryol
news.summary: China gives way to Russia on Black Sea security, and Moscow lets Beijing reshape the trade routes around it.

news.title: Russia’s Shadow Fleet Now Sails Under Its Own Flag
news.author: Simone Chiusa
news.summary: Europe found a legal way to board Russia’s shadow tankers, and Moscow closed it by handing them Russian flags and frigate escorts.

news.title: Preparedness for the AI Era Requires a Reserve of Critical Workers
news.summary: If governments or employers assume that permanent AI automation is right around the corner, vital training and career pipelines could collapse. We could find ourselves without enough people to perform work essential for our society to function.

news.title: Frozen Conflicts Are Russia’s Strategy, Not a Path to Peace in Ukraine
news.author: Halina Sapeha & Emmanuel Brunet-Jailly
news.summary: Freezing Ukraine’s front line would follow the pattern Russia set in Transnistria, Abkhazia, and South Ossetia.

news.title: The Procurement Trap: India’s Post-Sindoor Arms Spree
news.author: Sibra Waseem
news.summary: India has approved more than ₹10 trillion in arms since Operation Sindoor, from 114 Rafale fighters to K-9 Vajra howitzers.

news.title: The Kremlin’s African Bargain: How Washington Can Challenge Russia on the Continent
news.author: Ben Poulin
news.summary: Washington is courting Mali’s junta again, two years after Russia’s Africa Corps replaced US troops in Niger.

news.title: Lessons from L.A. on Transfer Taxes
news.summary: San Francisco voters have a new proposition on real estate transfer taxes to consider. Aspects of and arguments for the new Prop 1 closely mirror the debate over Los Angeles' Measure ULA, a 2022 ballot initiative that established a similar transfer tax and funding program.

news.title: Putin’s Iran Gambit: What Is Russia Trying to Achieve?
news.author: Elkhan Nuriyev
news.summary: Russia wants to preserve Iran as a strategic partner while navigating the economic and geopolitical consequences of a war it cannot control.

news.title: Canada’s Security Strategy Goes Realist | Geopolitics Weekly
news.author: Zachary Fillingham
news.summary: Canada’s new security strategy names no enemy. Plus Algeria sends troops to Niger, and Afghan opium cultivation jumps 330%.

news.title: Why Employers Can't Tame Health Costs
news.summary: Price transparency alone isn’t helping employers rein in health care costs. What will it take to give them real leverage—and overcome the barriers of today’s system?
